editorNote: Alphabet's record drop dominates a day when gold, bitcoin and Wall Street all fell. Headlines are drawn from the outlets linked; article bodies were not retrievable, so details are limited to what those outlets' headlines state.

stories.headline: Alphabet suffers its worst day on record, with about $500 billion in value erased after Q3 results
stories.summary: NBC News, BBC and CNN report Alphabet's shares fell on Thursday in their worst single day ever, shedding roughly $500 billion in market value. Reuters ties the drop to a revenue miss that revived AI capital-spending worries, and Mashable cites a $1 trillion-plus AI bill and negative cash flow. This follows yesterday's after-hours drop.
stories.whyItMatters: The after-hours move reported yesterday became a record one-day loss at the close, and Wall Street ended lower.

sourceLinks.title: Alphabet shares record their worst day ever, shedding $500 billion in value - NBC News
Google value plunges by $500bn as its own AI search hits ad sales - BBC

stories.headline: Gold slips below $4,000 as Middle East concerns mount
stories.summary: Yahoo Finance reports gold fell below $4,000 on Friday, and USA Today puts the day's decline at 2.19%. CoinWeek frames the move as the safe-haven trade turning upside down.
stories.whyItMatters: Spot gold has now broken under the $4,000 level that earlier coverage had flagged as nearby.

Gold Price Today: Gold Falls 2.19% on October 30, 2026 - USA Today

stories.headline: Binance hack: bitcoin falls to about $76,400 with $1.57 billion in liquidations
stories.summary: CoinDesk reports bitcoin fell to $76,400 as the Binance hack triggered $1.57 billion in liquidations. Reuters and Bloomberg report prices dropped after Binance disclosed a security issue, with a wider stock selloff also weighing.
stories.whyItMatters: Bitcoin was trading near $81,000 earlier this week; the hack drove a leveraged unwind.

sourceLinks.title: BTC price falls to $76,400 Binance hack triggers $1.57 billion in liquidations: Crypto Markets Today - CoinDesk

stories.headline: Binance heist linked to North Korean hackers; TRM Labs puts the theft at $6.36 billion
stories.summary: TRM Labs describes the Binance theft as the largest hack in history, at USD 6.36 billion, attributing it to North Korea. Yahoo Finance reports the hackers were linked to the record $6.3 billion heist.
stories.whyItMatters: The attribution and size are the figures analysts now cite.

sourceLinks.title: North Korea Steals USD 6.36 Billion From Binance in the Largest Hack in History - TRM Labs
North Korean hackers linked to record-breaking $6.3 billion Binance crypto heist - Yahoo Finance

stories.headline: Rocket Lab stock is up 15% over a five-day winning streak, Trefis says
stories.summary: Trefis reports Rocket Lab shares climbed 15% over five consecutive winning sessions. Yahoo Finance's headline says a NASA robot eyes repairs while Neutron advances and the 100th Electron ships.
stories.whyItMatters: The rally follows a stretch of declines covered earlier this month.

stories.headline: Duolingo investors reminded of a December 7 lead-plaintiff deadline in a securities class action
stories.summary: Levi & Korsinsky is urging Duolingo shareholders to act before a December 7, 2026 lead-plaintiff deadline, one of many law-firm notices about the class action.
stories.whyItMatters: The deadline sets when shareholders must seek a lead role in the suit; the notices are law-firm promotion, not court findings.

sourceLinks.title: Levi & Korsinsky Urges Duolingo, Inc. (DUOL) Shareholders to Act Before Lead Plaintiff Deadline December 7, 2026 - ACCESS Newswire

stories.headline: Alibaba ADR underperforms the market as it adds AI cloud capacity in Amsterdam
stories.summary: MarketWatch reports the Alibaba ADR fell on Thursday and underperformed the market. TradingView links the decline to Alibaba adding AI cloud capacity in Amsterdam.
stories.whyItMatters: The capacity addition coincided with a down day for the shares.
